# Abdul Rahman — IT & Digital Media Professional Portfolio

## Overview
Personal portfolio of Abdul Rahman, an IT & Digital Media Professional building fast, SEO-ready websites, e-commerce stores and brand content.

## Services Offered

1. **Web Development** — Custom Next.js, React and TypeScript builds.
   Tags: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
2. **E-commerce & Store Management** — Store setup, product and inventory management, checkout optimisation.
   Tags: Shopify, WooCommerce, Product Management, Payments, Order fulfilment
3. **Shopify Store Setup & Growth** — Custom Shopify builds, Liquid themes, apps and conversion tweaks.
   Tags: Shopify, Liquid, Theme Customisation, Apps & Integrations, Store SEO
4. **UI/UX & Web Design** — User-centred interfaces, design systems, responsive layouts.
   Tags: Figma, Wireframing, Prototyping, Design Systems, Responsive Layouts
5. **Graphic Designing** — Logos, brand kits, social posts, banners, print-ready artwork.
   Tags: Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Logo Design, Brand Identity, Social Media Kits
6. **Video Editing** — Cuts, colour grading, subtitles, motion graphics for reels and promos.
   Tags: Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Colour Grading, Subtitles, Short-form Reels
7. **SEO & Digital Content** — Technical SEO, on-page optimisation, content writing, structured data.
   Tags: Technical SEO, Keyword Research, Schema Markup, Content Writing, Analytics
8. **Deployment & Technical Support** — Vercel/Shopify deployment, Git/GitHub, domain/DNS, troubleshooting.
   Tags: Vercel, Shopify, Git/GitHub, Domain/DNS, SSL, Monitoring
